description: A dim, empty meeting hall with brick walls and a wooden lectern at left. A lit kerosene lantern glows on a long wooden table beside a gavel and scattered papers. Cream-topped dark peaked caps sit on the table and on chairs, and dark navy coats hang over chairs in the foreground. Rows of empty wooden chairs face the room, with an American flag on the back wall. No people are visible. The image fills the frame edge to edge.
reason: The scene asks for a crowd of Black Pullman porters with one man addressing them. The image shows an empty hall with porter-style caps, coats and a lantern, so it suggests the setting but shows no people and no union meeting. An artist should add the porters and the speaker.
